offering_description.value: Provides cloud software for nonprofits, foundations, educational institutions and companies running giving programs. Products cover fundraising, donor management, grant and CSR management, financial management, and school administration. Delivered mainly as subscription software, with payment processing.

primary_products.value: fundraising and donor management software; nonprofit financial management software; grant and giving management software; K-12 school management software

primary_services.value: payment processing; implementation and consulting; managed services; training and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: nonprofits, foundations, corporations, private K-12 schools, higher education institutions, healthcare organizations

end_markets.value: nonprofits; education; philanthropy and foundations; corporate social responsibility; healthcare

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring cloud software subscriptions; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees on donations and tuition payments; service fees: implementation, consulting, training and managed services
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts cloud software sold to nonprofits, schools and giving organizations

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, also Canada, UK, Australia and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: fundraising, financial, grant management, education and payments software for the social good community

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to nonprofits, schools and corporations; partners / resellers: channel partners and consultants; online: online marketplace and web-based payment tools

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules (GDPR, state privacy laws), PCI payment card standards, money transmission and charity regulations
